question: Who won the Toyota Thailand Open Women’s Singles Title in Bangkok in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carolina Marin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Carolina Marin**__ is a professional badminton player from Spain.
 
• She became the World Champion in the women's singles three times**, 2014, 2015, and 2018.**
 
• She is the Second female badminton athlete to win three women's singles World Champion titles after** Han Aiping** of China.
 
• Carolina Marin won the Toyota Thailand Open Women’s Singles Title in Bangkok in January 2021.
 __
 
• She defeated Taiwanese's** Tai Tzu-Ying** in the final.
 
 
 
• She consecutively won the **European Championships title five times** between 2014 and 2021 (2014, 2016, 2017, 2018, and 2021.)
 
• She is currently the brand ambassador of football major **LaLiga **for its promotion in other countries.
 
• She won the **gold medal in 2016 Rio de Janeiro** in the Women's singles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashwini Ponnappa** is a professional badminton player from India.
 
• **PV Sindhu** is an Indian professional badminton player who won a bronze medal for India in 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• **Tai Tzu-Ying** is a Taiwanese professional badminton player who won the gold medal in the 2018 Asian Games.
